facts.claim: Mykonos Blu (Grecotel) has a live 'Weddings & Vow Renewals' page (modified 21 October 2026) offering wedding experiences on Psarou beach with the sunset as a backdrop. Venue type: 5-star beachfront hotel described as a Cycladic settlement on the waterfront, with 103 guest rooms.

Mykonos Blu ceremony option as stated: The Ocean Balcony, accommodating up to 60 guests, perched just above Psarou beach with an uninterrupted sea view. After the ceremony the hotel can arrange a wedding table and party for up to 120 guests in its L'Archipel restaurant and pool area. Exclusive use is not published.
Mykonos Blu standout as stated: dedicated wedding specialists, customised menus and trusted vendors, with a 'Request for weddings' enquiry form; vow renewals are also offered.

Kivotos (Kivotos Hotels, Mykonos) has a live 'Luxury Weddings in Mykonos' page (last modified 8 February 2022) saying the beachfront hotel has a private chapel within its premises, 'ideal for an intimate' wedding. Venue type: beachfront boutique hotel with rooms and suites.

Kivotos says its most popular wedding reception venue is the entire area around the main pool on the hotel's lower level, against the Aegean backdrop. No capacity and no exclusive-use terms are published on the page.

Kivotos standout as stated: newlyweds may spend their first days aboard the hotel's privately owned schooner 'Prince de Neufchatel'. The page lists three named wedding packages (Dreamy Life, Live Life & Love Life, Get Together) and says hotel wedding coordinators help with items including municipal paperwork and the marriage licence (venue's own claim; no amounts shown on the page).

Saint John Hotel Villas & Spa has a live weddings page saying it 'offers a variety of wedding venues and event spaces', located in Agios Ioannis, which it calls one of Mykonos' most iconic sunset spots. Venue type: hotel, villas and spa resort.

Saint John ceremony and reception options as stated: vows at Agia Fotini Chapel, the sunset balcony or the deck; receptions at Theatraki, 1001 Nights, Ilios or Thalatta (the page calls these ideal for indoor wedding venues). All venues are described as having full sea views.

Saint John capacity as stated: intimate gatherings or large weddings with up to 800 guests, from welcome cocktails to five-course gala dinners. The property works with experienced wedding planners for flowers, DJs, photography, fireworks and similar, and says additional charges apply (no amounts). Exclusive use is not published.

Ftelia Bay Hotel's own site (an undated 'Explore Mykonos' Q&A blog post, read live) says a wedding ceremony and pre-dinner cocktail can be held at the hotel's private chapel, with traditional architecture and sea views, and that the open-air swimming pool area can host an event or wedding. Address on the page: Ftelia Beach, Mykonos 846 00. Venue type: boutique hotel.

Ftelia Bay standout as stated: specially designed menus for receptions or cocktail parties, rooms and suites for guests, and concierge help with transfers, beauty, decoration and photography. No capacity or exclusive-use terms are published. The page sits in a blog list whose neighbouring posts date to 2016 and 2017, so the offer may be dated.

Royal Myconian (site name 'Myconian Royal') has a live 'Weddings & Events' page (modified 31 July 2025) saying the Myconian Collection's event expertise covers 'fairytale Mykonos weddings', with a selection of venues, restaurants and accommodation and an events team. The page mentions a pool terrace and a private spot on Elia Beach. It names no ceremony spaces, capacity or exclusive-use terms; wedding statements are at Myconian Collection group level.

Villa Joy Mykonos's live 'Events & Shootings' page (modified 4 May 2026) offers events and photoshoots, a DJ set and loudspeakers for rent, introductions to transfer companies and an external chef, but does not mention weddings. It therefore does not qualify as a wedding venue example on today's read.

insider_details.detail: Mykonos Blu separates ceremony and party: up to 60 on The Ocean Balcony and up to 120 at L'Archipel and the pool, so a guest list above 60 needs a different ceremony plan; ask early.

Saint John's 800-guest ceiling and multiple sea-view spaces make it one of the few published options for a very large Mykonos wedding; ask which spaces combine and whether any exclusive use is possible.

Chapel ceremonies are on offer at Kivotos, Saint John (Agia Fotini) and Ftelia Bay; ask each whether the chapel suits a civil or symbolic ceremony, because a chapel setting says nothing about the legal form.
Venue wedding pages vary in age (Kivotos last modified 2022, Ftelia Bay undated among 2016 to 2017 posts), so confirm current packages and spaces with the venue before quoting them to couples.
